resolution.note: krn state set refuses a fixed point without base=/HEAD=/fingerprint=; set and check share hasFixedPointAnchor

title: Refuse a fixed-point value in krn state set that state check rejects
body:
Outcome: krn state set refuses a fixed-point value that krn state check reports as missing-fixed-point.
Why: on 2026-11-09 the lead set the fingerprint field to 'main da62997 clean' and then a full SHA without HEAD=; set exited 0 both times and check then failed with missing-fixed-point (session e6cd06a1). #504 promised set refuses values check rejects.
Proof: test/state/write.test.ts sets a fingerprint without base=/HEAD= and expects exit 64 naming the HEAD=<sha> form.
Scope: src/state/write.ts, test/state/write.test.ts.
